Bid Award Panel grant authority to award the contract in accordance with the Contract Details set out in the report (August 1, 2024) from the Chief Procurement Officer: Solicitation Number: Request for Quotation Doc4567280605 Description: For the non-exclusive supply and delivery of Ferno Stretchers and Accessories to various Purchasing and Materials Management (Stores) locations from the date of award to July 31, 2025, with the option to renew the Contract for four (4) additional one (1)-year periods at the sole discretion of the City and subject to budget approval(s). The Request for Quotation is structured to award contract to the lowest supplier meeting specifications and providing the lowest total bid price of the Pricing Form.
